reason: Reproduced: Tab and Shift+Tab skip Show sankey chart, because the selected segment has tabindex=-1. But Enter on it changes nothing (same URL, same chart), the other three segments are reachable, and after Enter on Show stacked bar chart the sankey button is back in the tab order. Keyboard users lose no function.
criterionAnalysis: 2.1.1 requires all functionality to be operable by keyboard. The only control Tab skips is the one for the mode already showing; activating it is a no-op, and switching to the sankey chart by keyboard works from any other mode. 2.4.3 focus order stays logical (overview, line, stacked bar, then the insight actions). 4.1.2 name and role are exposed (button "Show sankey chart"). That the selected mode is not announced is a different claim from this finding and was not evaluated here.
